question: Does the pipeline's own ASR timeline sit at a constant offset from a human subtitle, on real data?
method: scripts/eval_srt_quality.py (word-anchored) comparing the newest production-settings cached transcript (rendered as cues) with the human .tr.srt of Love Is In The Air (2020) S01E01-E04; plus ffprobe start_time of the 36 distinct videos the video jobs processed
interpretation: Negative offset = candidate earlier than reference. All four classify constant_offset, ~0.12-0.18 s, far from 5.1 s. These are source-language ASR cues against a human reference of the same release; the English output was not measured. The reported ~5.1 s pair is a different file and is still missing.
